name: main-write-lock-async-reentrancy-fix
title: Parallel-dev robustness: fix main-write-lock async-reentrancy race (DONE-merge lost commit) + global-fallback guard brand
description: Fix the High-severity intermittent bug where a DONE story is marked DONE but never merged to main (manual git merge needed; hit B-be91 + B-2941 this session). Root cause: the in-process main-write-lock reentrancy registry (bare process-global Set) mis-classifies a concurrent async sibling (another story's INIT_CHECK running in the same process during a DONE-merge await) as a nested reentrant caller, so it skips real lock acquisition and commits to main mid-merge. Make reentrancy async-context-aware via AsyncLocalStorage. Also fix the global-fallback guard brand mismatch (codex-adapter-checks.ts probes @lattice-agent/core but the install is @koala-agent/core, so the heartbeat-only warning never fires). Out of scope: on-disk mkdir mutex (frozen), done-effects merge order (correct), CHANGELOG structure (#3 dropped — zero conflicts in history).
